nodes.label: SilverChat 21-Table Postgres Schema (0001_initial_schema.sql)
nodes.rationale: Defines 13 enums and 21 tables (profiles, user_settings, devices, chats, chat_members, messages, message_receipts, message_reactions, message_deletions, chat_requests, user_blocks, reports, stories, story_views, channels, channel_followers, communities, community_members, calls, file_uploads, app_config).

nodes.label: Unified Chats & Unified Messages Architecture
nodes.rationale: Consolidates direct, group, self, and community_chat into a single chats table (with deterministic direct_pair_key and denormalized last_message_* fields) and merges chat and channel messages into a single messages table with a mutually exclusive chat_id XOR channel_id constraint.

nodes.label: Decoupled File Metadata (file_uploads) & Storage Seam (src/lib/storage.ts)
nodes.rationale: Separates file metadata in file_uploads from private Supabase Storage buckets (avatars, chat-media, story-media, channel-media) and wraps client SDK access in src/lib/storage.ts with client-side WebP compression to enable quotas and future migration to R2/B2/S3.

nodes.label: handle_new_user() Auth Onboarding Trigger
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER trigger on auth.users AFTER INSERT that automatically provisions public.profiles (with placeholder username user_<8hex>) and public.user_settings rows.
